environment: Local Docker PostgreSQL 17.10, ARM; work_mem=4MB; serial scale runs; strict mode on and superuser bypass off
measurement: Execution uses EXPLAIN ANALYZE; wall is the median of three executions. largest_scan_rows includes rows removed by filters/rechecks, multiplied by loops. Baseline bound queries replay on the same fixture and must return identical rows.

failures.error: canceling statement due to statement timeout
canceling statement due to statement timeout

limitations: Four baseline cells timed out during read or EXPLAIN. The early baseline harness did not retain the stage, so no wall-time lower bound or exact-result baseline claim is inferred. Final variant records retain the stage and any completed wall samples.
Initial E/Minimal runs overlapped brief SQLite diagnostics and were superseded. The reported PG16 E/Minimal runs were repeated serially after all other tests finished.
The fixed PG17 ceiling is also exceeded by the baseline at k=16. Both candidates reduce memory relative to it; this does not waive the absolute ceiling.
Experimental inline scope emission fails an additional mixed-actor nested-WITH smoke test. Neither prototype is production-ready.
PG17 runs cover the embedding planning/memory cases, not a duplicate full read matrix; no final accepted variant exists.

actors.large: direct grants on every even thread (50%), inherited by messages and parts
actors.member: thread 1 via nested group plus direct message 2; arrow-only sees thread 1 only
actors.team: one group grants every twentieth thread (5%)

method.arrow_only: message.read = thread->read; admin arm on thread only
method.baseline_loading: git show 65754b2 compiler package, imported under an isolated rebac package; current ctes collector adapter shared to embed old SQL in current queryset roots
method.fixture: 50,000 threads, one message per thread, 500,000 parts, id i maps to message 1 + (i - 1) % 50,000; fragment_id=i
method.planning_ms: EXPLAIN ANALYZE for read cells, EXPLAIN SUMMARY for k-embedding cases
method.planning_shape: narrow team ScopePart root with k correlated scoped ScopeMessage Exists filters in WHERE; planned with EXPLAIN SUMMARY, not executed
method.row_sets: expected_rows_key and rows_key reference exact ordered row sets in row_sets; counts are single-row single-column results
method.shared: schema exposes both read and inspect through message->read; root plus scoped Exists(ScopePart) refer to the target

variants.E: correlated EXISTS targets and shared-set probes; scope EXISTS retained inside CASE; universal witnesses and fence sharing retained; own-PK self-probe removed when the resolved predicate needs no other live local join
variants.Minimal: universal witness CASE and shared fences; non-universal fallback uses native IN sets and UNION enumeration; universal presence is EXISTS; same own-PK self-probe removal; no scalar target lookup

method.wall_ms: median of 3 cursor execute/fetchall wall times following an excluded warm-up, using Django-compiled SQL; Python queryset construction excluded and first compilation recorded separately
